thought.text: Signup captcha tidak ada di bundle utama — kemungkinan di chunk lazy. Saya cari langsung dengan mencoba header yang mungkin.

action.command: cd /workspace/project && curl -s --noproxy '*' --max-time 60 "https://dash.allmodels.io/assets/signup-BDkSiWkG.js" -o /tmp/su.js -w "guess HTTP %{http_code}\n"; grep -oE 'assets/[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*(signup|SignUp|register|auth)[a-zA-Z0-9_-]*\.js' /tmp/am.js | sort -u | head; echo "=== semua chunk yg disebut ==="; grep -oE 'assets/[a-zA-Z0-9_.-]{5,60}\.js' /tmp/am.js | sort -u | grep -iE 'sign|auth|reg|login' | head -10
